package.title: Tempo.Blazor.Proofing.LanguageTool
package.description: Reference LanguageTool proofing provider (ITempoProofingProvider) for the Tempo.Blazor document editor, including Czech spellcheck support against a self-hosted LanguageTool server.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.Proofing.LanguageTool
gettingStarted.overview: Reference LanguageTool proofing provider (ITempoProofingProvider) for the Tempo.Blazor document editor, including Czech spellcheck support against a self-hosted LanguageTool server.

items.description: Configuration for LanguageToolProofingProvider: server base address (falls back to HttpClient.BaseAddress, then the self-host default http://localhost:8010), default language ("auto" for detection; CreateCzech() preconfigures cs-CZ), mother tongue hint, disabled rules/categories, the client-side CustomDictionary word set, max text length per check and the per-issue suggestion cap.

members.name: CreateCzech
members.description: Creates options preconfigured for Czech proofing (cs-CZ).

members.name: BaseAddress
members.description: Base address of the LanguageTool server (self-hosted or hosted). The provider posts to {BaseAddress}/v2/check. When null, the of the injected client is used, falling back to the self-host default http://localhost:8010.

members.name: CustomDictionary
members.description: Client-side custom dictionary: findings whose flagged word is contained here are suppressed without a server round-trip. Case-insensitive. Use this for app-specific terminology (brand names, Czech legal terms) that a stock LanguageTool dictionary flags.

members.name: DisabledCategories
members.description: LanguageTool category ids disabled for every check (e.g. STYLE).

members.name: DisabledRules
members.description: LanguageTool rule ids disabled for every check (e.g. WHITESPACE_RULE).

members.name: Language
members.description: Default BCP-47 language sent to the server when the check request does not carry its own language. Use "auto" for server-side language detection.

members.name: MaxSuggestionsPerIssue
members.description: Maximum number of replacement suggestions kept per finding.

members.name: MaxTextLength
members.description: Maximum number of characters sent per check; longer text is truncated.

members.name: MotherTongue
members.description: Optional mother tongue hint for false-friend detection.

items.description: Reference ITempoProofingProvider speaking the LanguageTool v2 HTTP protocol (POST {base}/v2/check with form-encoded text + language, JSON matches response). Works against a self-hosted LanguageTool container (see docs/proofing-languagetool.md for the compose file) or any protocol-compatible endpoint; supports Czech via Language="cs-CZ". Findings whose word is in the client-side CustomDictionary are suppressed, and AddToDictionary(word) suppresses a word for subsequent checks.

members.name: AddToDictionary
members.description: Adds a word to the client-side custom dictionary so it is no longer reported.
